staff_settings_lock_health_none_confirme: None confirmed on the lock yet — one is minted by the daily job.
staff_settings_lock_health_replacement_i: A replacement is on its way to the lock. The current code keeps working until it lands.
staff_settings_manage_credentials_third_: Manage credentials for third-party integrations. Changes take effect immediately.
staff_settings_member_s_first_rehearsal_: A member's first rehearsal booking gets one shift in this role. No role, no shift.
staff_settings_organization_identity_use: Organization identity used in emails, branding, and member-facing content.
staff_settings_reconciles_every_member_b: Reconciles every member and band subscription status from Stripe into the local database. Use this as a one-time backfill after migration, or any time to re-sync if a webhook was missed. For active members it also tops up any missing monthly credits by replaying their latest paid invoice — it never reduces a balance already spent down this month, and leaves canceled members' credits untouched.

staff_settings_shown_site_footer_leave_b: Shown in the site footer. Leave blank to hide.
staff_settings_contact_email_shown_text: Shown on public pages and in account emails.
staff_settings_stripe_product_will_creat: Stripe product will be created on first checkout
staff_settings_unmanaged_lock_codes_ever: Every standing code on the lock is accounted for.

staff_settings_utec_device_picker_descri: No devices on this account yet.

staff_settings_utec_state_error_toast: Security check failed — please try connecting again.

It covers every approved hour — contributed services under FASB are a narrower figure carried per volunteer role, and the two are reported separately rather than added.

staff_suggestions_id_reject_keep_what_me: Reject — keep what members voted for

staff_volunteer_needs_scheduling_card_de: When the window ends, close any equipment reports on this and tell the reporters it was fixed. Off, it waits on the Schedule for you to verify.
staff_volunteer_needs_scheduling_card_on: Once it has a window it appears on the schedule and members can claim it.
staff_volunteer_needs_scheduling_card_sa: Says the work is finished, which is not the same as anybody having turned up. Anyone on it is completed at the same time.
staff_volunteer_roles_blank_means_never_: Blank means it never lapses. Changing this affects future grants only — an existing grant keeps the expiry it was stamped with.
Blank means it never lapses. Changing this applies to future grants only — the {holderCount} already issued keep the expiry they were stamped with.
staff_volunteer_roles_clearance_somethin: A clearance is something a volunteer must hold before they can take certain roles: a background check, a training, a sign-off. Create one with New Clearance, then open a role and mark that it requires it.
staff_volunteer_roles_description_help_b: Markdown. This is what members read on their volunteering page, so say what the job actually involves.
staff_volunteer_roles_disappears_from_gr: It disappears from the grant form. Everyone who holds it keeps it, and roles that require it still require it.
staff_volunteer_roles_grants_made_person: Grants are made on a person's record. A renewal is a new row, never an edit — which is what keeps "was their card current on the night?" answerable.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_blank_counts_as: Blank counts as zero, never as the impact rate — a report shows it as unpriced.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_every_approved_: Every approved hour counts toward the collective's impact value, at the rate on the settings page. A {#em}{staff_volunteer_roles_id_specialized_skill}{/em} is narrower: work we would otherwise have had to pay for, which a financial statement can recognise as a contributed service — at what that skill costs, not at the impact rate. The two are reported side by side and never added together.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_lower_sorts_fir: Lower sorts first, within this group.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_markdown_what_m: Markdown. This is what members read on their volunteering page, so say what the job actually involves.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_member_skill_ta: Member skill tags, as members write them. A member with one of these ranks higher on a shift's Who to ask list. It never stops anyone being asked.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_members_will_ab: Members will be able to log hours against this again.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_members_won_t_a: Members won't be able to log new hours against this role. Existing hours stay in the queue and in every report.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_nothing_has_bee: Nothing has been logged against this role, so it can be removed outright.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_role_grants_car: This role grants nothing beyond claiming its shifts.
A volunteer confirmed on a shift in this role can do these for that shift's event and no other. You can only grant what your own position allows.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_role_interested: Couldn't copy — your browser blocked clipboard access
No one has picked this role yet.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_role_requiremen: Anyone can claim a shift for this role — no clearance needed.
Someone must hold all of these before they can claim a shift for this role. Logging hours is never blocked — the review queue just flags it.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_role_shifts_car: Nothing scheduled for this role yet.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_what_new_shift_: What the New Shift form starts with. Not a limit — either can be changed on the shift itself, and leaving them blank just means the form starts on its own defaults.
staff_volunteer_roles_id_work_collective: Work the collective would otherwise have paid for.
staff_volunteer_roles_leave_blank_someth: Leave blank for something CMC signs off itself.
staff_volunteer_roles_nobody_holds_so_ca: Nobody holds this, so it can be removed outright.
staff_volunteer_roles_role_name_plus_wha: A role is a name plus what the job involves. Members pick from this list.
staff_volunteer_roles_staff_will_able_gr: Staff will be able to grant this again.
staff_volunteer_schedule_description_bod: Widen the window, or clear the filters.

match.unconfirmedPlural=one: {unconfirmed} person has put a hand up for {shiftLabel} on {formatDateShort}. Confirming books them: each gets the reminder the day before, and the shift completes afterwards with hours to log.
match.unconfirmedPlural=*: {unconfirmed} people have put a hand up for {shiftLabel} on {formatDateShort}. Confirming books them: each gets the reminder the day before, and the shift completes afterwards with hours to log.

staff_volunteer_schedule_recurring_recur: No new work orders. The open one stays queued.
Counted from when the last one closed.
staff_where_van_goes_which_door_body: Where the van goes, which door is unlocked, who has the key.
